eattheday.text: EatTheDay waits, then strikes: matchup rating and resistance both among the very best, with a matchup K/D line that matches. The bravery number is near the bottom, the headshot share nearly absent, which fits a player who lets the fight come to them instead of chasing it. The lifetime board paints a far humbler picture, with the lifetime IvI near the very bottom while the matchups sit at the top.

evasiva.text: Evasiva plays the complete game: matchup rating, pace, and bravery all at the top, with resistance that refuses to bend against the hardest attacks. Headshots sit mid-pack, so body shots carry the load — and carry it well, with accuracy near the top. Consistency lands mid-pack too, the lone wrinkle in an otherwise flawless card. A polished, versatile fighter with no real hole to poke.

emeraldtester2432.text: emeraldtester2432 plays a measured, stubborn game: rating and resistance in the upper tier, tempo and bravery just behind, with the matchup kill-death mark holding its ground. Accuracy and headshot share sit mid-pack, yet the results stay elite — the edge comes from judgment, not raw aim. The lifetime IvI sits mid-pack too, so the matchups tell the stronger story.

eyfia.text: Eyfia wastes no motion: the matchup rating runs near the top, the tempo sits just as high, and the game keeps rising as the enemies get tougher. Accuracy runs well above average and headshots land there too, the kill rate runs above average, and the lifetime ledger sits in the same strong bracket. A sharp, efficient presence that keeps delivering.

elelnos.text: ELElNOS plays a polished, high-tempo game with output sitting near the top; a game that rises as enemies improve. Accuracy lands among the elite few, with the matchup rating sitting near the top, the lifetime board confirming that verdict, and consistency above average too, so the edge holds against the strongest third.

eggbreakerr.text: Eggbreakerr wastes nothing: rating near the top, activity close behind, bravery and resistance near the top, kills coming at a top rate. The aim is sharp, headshots land near the top, with lifetime numbers landing near the top as well. The matchup kill-death mark sits a notch below the rest, the only modest line on a strong card.

empha.text: Empha is a young account already playing near the top: matchup rating, bravery, resistance, and kill-death all in the top ranks, with pace above average. Shots land clean and headshots plentiful, while consistency sits mid-pack — the one line still catching up. The lifetime record has them above average, a step below the matchups, and the start already speaks volumes.

effectns.text: EffectNS is a precision instrument: a high-tempo engine, nerve to match, and elite resistance, with accuracy among the best tracked and a lifetime board right there too. The kills arrive at a top rate, and the headshots follow. The consistency mark falls below average, the lone blemish on an otherwise flawless card.

exonc.text: exonc has played since 2016 with a sharp, resilient edge: resistance and matchup kill-death near the top, bravery and activity well above average. The consistency mark sits near the bottom, so the game fades hard against the strongest third. Still, the accuracy stays well above average and the lifetime numbers sit above average, enough for a top-tier record.

eurowinna.text: EUROWINNA plays a sharp, high-volume game: activity and bravery near the very top, with accuracy and headshots both near the top. The lifetime board rates them among the very best tracked, and the consistency mark sits near the top as well. A complete game with every line reading strong.

ezzzzzzzzzzzzzzztrw.text: ezzzzzzzzzzzzzzztrw has barely arrived and already plays like a fixture: rating, activity, resistance, and matchup kill-death all sit near the very top. The game holds only middling ground as the opposition improves, and the consistency mark dips below average, so the shape still has rough edges. Early read on a young account, but the opening pages already carry real weight.

ericfreeman1.text: Ericfreeman1 has been at this since 2015, and it shows in the steadiness: a top-shelf rating, a head-to-head ledger near the very best, and resistance that barely bends against stronger opposition. The lifetime board sits just below the matchups, and the edge narrows a touch against the hardest third. A veteran built on patience and timing.

erendil.text: Since 2012, Erendil has made a career out of winning the fights that count: upper tier across the matchup board, a direct-fight kill-death record up near the summit, and resistance that gives little away. The pace is unhurried and the aim ordinary, yet the results keep landing high. The lifetime board tells a plainer tale, middling where the matchups read strong.

eu460vs.text: EU460VS plays a game built on pressure: upper-tier matchup rating, tempo near the top, and resistance that barely bends. The duel kill-death line sits just under the summit, and the lifetime ledger agrees with the matchups. The one soft seam in an otherwise strong card: the edge thins against the hardest third.

eternitheartnc.text: EternitHeartNc plays with the throttle open: activity and bravery top-tier, a kill pace to match, and headshots at a top rate. The matchup rating sits top-tier too, and the lifetime ledger among the very best. The soft spot: when the opposition reaches its hardest, the edge gives ground, consistency below average on an otherwise loud card.

eternalrebel.text: EternalRebel has been a fixture since 2018: tempo near the top, bravery close behind, and a kill pace that ranks with the quickest tracked. The aim is sharp, the lifetime board reads well above average, and headshots sit mid-pack. The edge keeps most of its bite when the pressure peaks — a veteran still playing at full tilt.

euno1sa.text: EUNO1SA plays a clean, complete game: well above average across the matchup board, bravery near the top, and accuracy among the sharpest tracked. The lifetime board stands near the top, headshots land a touch above average, and the pace runs above average. The toughest third barely dents the edge — a regular with no quiet corners.

estreiia.text: EstreIIa has been fighting since 2018 and still plays at full tilt: upper-tier matchup rating, top-shelf activity and bravery, and a head-to-head kill-death tally near the top. The lifetime board is far more modest, painting a middle-of-the-pack picture where the matchups see a strong one. Headshots rarely land, and facing the hardest third the edge comes apart — the two soft spots on an otherwise sharp card.

epictrashh.text: EpicTrashh plays a sharp, tidy game: clear of the middle in the matchups, level-headed as enemies get stronger, and brisk when the fight opens up. The lifetime numbers tell roughly the same story, which keeps things simple. Versus the strongest third, the edge sags below average — the one wrinkle in an otherwise solid card.

elyzianne.text: Elyzianne plays the long game: the lifetime kill-death line sits among the very best tracked, with a head-to-head kill-death line near the summit and resistance to match. The pace stays below average, accuracy near the bottom, and the lifetime IvI below average. Patience is the whole method — few engagements, chosen carefully, and almost every one of them won.

edeaflorence.text: EdeaFlorence is still a fresh name on the board and already playing like a fixture: tempo near the top, headshots near the top, and a lifetime board that reads taller than the matchups. The aim sits above average, the bravery solid, and the card reads strong throughout. The edge thins a little against the strongest third — an early read, but a loud one.

egypte.text: Egypte has played since 2016, and the lifetime kill-death line still runs near the top. The matchup mark lands well above average, with an edge that holds against the hardest third. The aim is ordinary, headshots mid-pack, but the results keep coming — a veteran who lets the scoreboard do the talking.

eilomia.text: Eilomia plays a measured game that keeps paying off: near the top on the matchup board, unshaken as the enemies sharpen, and hard to kill against stronger opposition. The faceoff ledger lands near the top too, while the lifetime kill-death line runs even higher. Accuracy and headshots sit well above average, rounding out a card with no soft corner.

executivepig.text: ExecutivePig has been fighting since 2015, and the card reads steady all the way through: the matchup rating clears the middle, and so do activity, bravery, and resistance, with the kill-death margin against peers to match. The lifetime numbers land mid-pack across the board — aim, headshots, and IvI alike. Nothing flashy, nothing fragile: a reliable regular who turns up and holds their own.

eranorznc.text: EranorzNC is a study in contrasts: the matchup board rates them well above average, and against the toughest opposition, the edge barely moves at all. The faceoff tally sits near the very best, yet headshots almost never land and the lifetime IvI sits near the bottom. A veteran since 2016 whose matchup game outshines the career numbers by a wide margin.

everymanaklng.text: EveryManAKlNG brings the complete game with no weak seam: well above average across the matchup board, brisk of pace, and steady as the fighting hardens. The peer-fight kill tally holds well above average, with the headshot share climbing above average too. Consistency sits mid-pack, the only ordinary line in a career that reads strong from first fight to last.

ennnnnnn.text: Ennnnnnn plays a deliberate game and makes it pay: comfortably clear of the middle across the matchup board, firm as the opposition hardens, and patient enough to let the fight come to them. The matchup kill tally runs high for someone at this tempo, and the lifetime board backs the matchups up. A steady regular with a sharp finishing instinct.

ettred1.text: Ettred1 arrived in 2025 and already plays like a fixture: a top-shelf tempo, bravery that holds firm as the opposition hardens, plus a kill-death split across the matchups that sits near the top. Accuracy runs well above average while headshots stay middling, and the lifetime numbers agree with the matchups. The one soft seam: the edge thins a touch against the strongest third.

eba6umava6u.text: Eba6uMava6u plays at full tilt. The pace sits near the top, the accuracy keeps up, and the lifetime board rides right up there too. The matchup mark clears the middle while tempo and bravery follow, and real fights leave a kill-death reckoning in step. Headshots land sharper than most, and only against the toughest third does the line soften — a single wrinkle in a fast, bright card.

ezzhasskillissue.text: EzzHasSkillIssue wins the strangest way on the board: the duel ledger sits at the very top, resistance holds there too, and the toughest-third edge keeps climbing. Yet headshots almost never land, the accuracy sits below average, while the lifetime IvI sits near the very bottom. A fighter who wins duels without ever needing the headshot — patient, unflustered, and quietly baffling.

eternithearttr.text: EternitHeartTR brings a high-tempo game with no wasted motion: a clip near the summit, bravery that grows with the opposition, and a headshot share above average. The duel returns hover in the middle, the lifetime ledger confirms the picture, and the edge holds steady against the strongest third. A regular already playing like a fixture.

eclatantevs.text: EclatanteVS has been sharpening the same game since 2017: clear of the middle on the matchup board, sharp of tempo, and unmoved as the enemies toughen. They close out more duels than they drop, and the lifetime kill count climbs near the very top. The lifetime rating sits above the middle, the accuracy too, and the headshots in the middle.

enensss.text: ENENSSS is a newer name with a settled game: strong across the matchup card, composed when the fight toughens, and the kill profit they take from real fights lands high. The aim is middling and the career ledger reads mid-pack too. The one wrinkle: the consistency line sags below the middle, so the strongest third claims its toll. A regular finding their feet and already holding their own.

erichunternso.text: EricHunterNSO brings a complete, aggressive game: well above average on every matchup line, brave as enemies toughen, and a one-versus-one kill margin near the summit. The accuracy sits near the summit too — yet the headshots almost never arrive, so the damage lands low. The lifetime ledger disagrees with the matchups, placing the IvI line near the floor. A regular whose shots find flesh, just not heads.

elpatronn.text: Since 2013, eLPaTronN has fought a steady, unflashy war: clearly above the average mark, measured on the trigger, and composed while the pressure mounts. The headshots are rare and the lifetime IvI sits below average, yet the results keep landing their way. A long career built on patience, not fireworks, and still showing up.

enchin1376.text: Enchin1376 plays a bright, uneven game: comfortably clear of the average line, quick through the exchanges, and composed as the fighting heats up. The matchup record outshines the middling lifetime numbers, which keeps the story honest. When the fighting gets hardest the edge fades, the one soft spot in a card still finding its shape.

edesertfox.text: EDesertFOX is a study in contrasts: strong on the adjusted board, yet lifetime IvI sits near the very bottom. Head-to-head results crowd the upper reaches, and resistance is top-shelf too — hard to put down, hard to shake. The aim is still finding itself, bravery sits mid-pack, and the edge fades sharply against the strongest opposition. The matchup results are genuinely striking all the same.

energy0n.text: Energy0N has been on the board since 2016, and the card is a model of steady excellence: above average on every count, a brisk tempo, and unruffled by stronger opposition. The head-to-head tally leans winning, and the lifetime numbers back the matchups. The consistency sits mid-pack, neither a strength nor a flaw — just a strong veteran who keeps delivering.

elexcoldxhot.text: EleXColdXhoT plays a busy, well-rounded game: above the middle on the matchup board, lively on the trigger, and steady as the fighting thickens. The head-to-head tally itself is only middling, while the lifetime numbers run a touch hotter. A veteran regular with no headline and no hole — the kind of card that wins quietly.

enenss.text: ENENSS is barely two weeks in and already fighting at full tilt: the tempo sits in the upper tier, the matchup tally lands near the top, and the headshots pile up fast. When the fighting gets heaviest the edge thins a touch, the one soft spot in an early run. Early read, yet the first fortnight is loud and confident.

eleinos.text: ELEINOS has played a steady hand since 2013: a shade above the pack across the matchup board, quick through each exchange, and calm against stronger opposition. The faceoff numbers sit mid-pack, a touch more modest than the rest of the card. More than a decade in, the game still looks the same: a dependable regular, strong without ever needing the spotlight.

elmuchospanko.text: ElMuchoSpanko has been fighting since 2013: a clear cut above the middle overall, measured on the trigger, and steady as the fighting gets harder. The direct-duel record sits above average, the lifetime kill-death line too, while the IvI line lands below average. Headshots are scarce, the one quiet gap. A long-time regular, still showing up, still holding their own.

esticaznc.text: EsticazNC plays a rounded game: well above average on the rating, the tempo, and the lifetime board, with only the matchup tally landing mid-pack. The pace does the hard work, turning ordinary exchanges into winning ones. Nothing flashy, nothing fragile — just a strong regular whose card reads the same however you weigh it.

esanyc.text: EsanYc brings a steady all-round game: well above average overall, comfortable as the opposition strengthens, and a tempo that stays brisk from first fight to last. The matchup record sits in the middle, while the lifetime figures run a notch hotter. A strong regular with no soft spot, just a solid game from start to finish.

eryand.text: Eryand plays a patient, unflashy game: well above average on balance, with staying power above mid-pack and a lifetime kill tally above the middle too. The pace is measured, the matchup tally ordinary, and the accuracy sits below average. Yet the results hold up where it counts, and the form stays steady as the opposition hardens. A quiet regular who does the work without chasing the spotlight.
